statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-45c3-73f7-pv4m (https://github.com/rthalley/dnspython/security/advisories/GHSA-45c3-73f7-pv4m): dns.name.from_wire_parser() can spend excessive CPU decompressing names in a crafted DNS message. Fixed in dnspython 2.9.0 by commit b485e460 (https://github.com/rthalley/dnspython/commit/b485e460c266540a1a09ca6d8d1d7b685b1d3023), which limits decompression to 16 pointers. Listed the files of every published airflow build, 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-7 (48 builds, amd64 and arm64), and read the dnspython version from its dist-info directory under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages; both architectures agree for every build. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.2-11 ship dnspython 2.8.0. Builds 3.3.2-12 to 3.3.2-14 ship 2.9.0, and 3.3.2-15 to the current 3.4.0-7 ship 2.9.1. The first build with the fix is 3.3.2-12.
